description: This PHP source file contains unit tests for the ViewDetail class within the SuiteCRM application, specifically testing methods related to setting up and rendering the detail view of entities like Users and Meetings. It uses PHPUnit framework assertions and mocks certain dependencies such as BeanFactory, Sugar_Smarty, and the ViewDetail class itself.

classes.name: ViewDetailTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ViewDetail class functionality within the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: testViewDetail
methods.description: Tests the constructor of ViewDetail to ensure it creates an object of the correct type and sets the 'type' attribute to 'detail'.

methods.name: testpreDisplay
methods.description: Tests the preDisplay method for different modules (Users and Meetings), verifying that the detail view ('dv') is initialized correctly and its 'defs' property is an array.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method of the ViewDetail class, ensuring it renders some HTML content for the 'Users' module with a set bean ID.
